record.one_liner: Global crypto exchange offering spot, margin, and futures trading and market data via REST and WebSocket APIs.
record.auth_notes: API keys are created in the account dashboard. Key types are Ed25519 (recommended), HMAC and RSA; requests are signed with the private key or secret, which is why 'other' is also listed.
record.access_notes: Live keys are free but need 2FA, a deposit of any amount to the Spot Account and identity verification first. A free Spot Test Network issues working keys with just a GitHub login, so a developer can build and test without funds. critic: access confirmed self_serve_free, testnet evidence added.
record.api_notes: Spot REST API plus separate derivatives (USDS-M and COIN-M futures), margin, convert and WebSocket APIs on the developer docs site.
record.blocker_notes: Self-serve keys and a documented public API. Live use needs a deposit and KYC; the free Spot testnet avoids that for development. Trading through the API moves real money, so keep test use on testnet or read-only keys. critic: verdict ready confirmed.
